display_long_description:
Start at the Moonrise Clubhouse: step through a portal to one of seven 18-hole courses, or stay for a game. Four courses are free to play; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley and Monster Mansion are add-ons.

NEW, MONSTER MANSION: A haunted house on a stormy night. A lagoon creature swats at your ball, a magnet floats it up to a cup on the ceiling, and the giant in the tower wakes when you sink the last putt. Free to play through November 8: finish a round by then and it's yours to keep.

NEW, CLUBHOUSE GAMES: Ping pong against Ollie the otter, with real spin and four levels. Bowling at sunset on a pier over the sea. Atomic Moonshot pinball, a rocket race to the moon with ramps, modes and multiball.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: Friendly dinosaurs, a mud luge and an erupting volcano.

LANTERN COVE: Golden hour by the sea, finishing under the lighthouse.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: A glowing night. Roll through root tunnels and up the Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: A cozy Halloween night. Finish inside the Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: The sunny city of tomorrow. Watch the Starliner lift off on 18.

GLOWTOWN: A neon showbiz city. Work the flippers on a sky-arcade pinball table.

DAILY CHALLENGE: A new one every day. Three tries, your best counts.

PLAY TOGETHER: Private games for up to four with voice chat; mute, block or report anyone.

REAL PUTTING: The ball is simulated 360 times a second. Find ten lost balls on every course. Seated mode, left-handed play, colour-blind friendly balls.
